This Charter sets out the procedure for assigning astronauts to perform a spacewalk (EVA) from the crew of the space station.

The flight controller, together with the station commander, prepares a list of candidates from among the astronauts who meet the following requirements:
- have the necessary qualifications and training to perform a given EVA;

The selected astronaut is assigned to perform the EVA. The assignment is approved by the flight controller and the station commander.

A change of assignment is allowed only in cases where the selected astronaut is unable to perform the EVA for objective reasons (illness, injury, etc.). In this case, a new selection is made from the remaining candidates in accordance with the procedure set out in clause 3.

All stages of selection and approval of the assignment are documented in the station log. The station commander is responsible for compliance with this Charter.
